schema_extensions_required: Three multi-turn specifications currently encode turn sequences in input text; true turn-by-turn evaluation requires a turns array and sequential replay support.
limitations: Specifications are AI drafts and have not been reviewed or approved by a human.
Behavior categories come from the parent draft labels and remain unreviewed.
Meeting five families per category is a planning target, not a statistical power guarantee.
No executable evaluation cases, references, or model-quality claims are created by this package.
